notes: Searched: '9419014 AMK', 'GM 9419014', '9419014 bolt', '9419014 180044'. Only lead: GM 80TS-RP (Sept 1979) supersession OCR shows '180044 9419014' (old 180044 replaced by 9419014), no size.
